notes: Round 10 (scratch_r3, stopped at 1.24M of 2M decisions when Paul asked for the 80M walkers' last checkpoints under the minds): with the store first again 69% die of old age, 30% starve, 2% are killed; a life in the world 531 s; feeding 16.5% of the time, store 0.71. Still no pair side by side. The deer that starve never ate (scratch_r2 in the engine: each dies 130 s after it came in): they are brought in on the border of the arena, on bare ground further from grass than the 10 m the mind sees, and nothing paid for the way to it. Round 11, first round of the line scratch80 (walkers from the 80M trainings at 65M, minds from scratch_r3): seek pays a hungry deer by the metre closed on the nearest grass (the new signal grass_closing); the rest unchanged.

terms.name: graze
terms.expr: 0.004 * step(0.8 - energy) * mode_feed * step(grass_here - 0.1) * max(0, 1 - muzzle_height)

terms.name: pair
terms.expr: 0.05 * adult * (1 - pregnant) * step(energy - 0.6) * mode_mate * step(4 - mate_distance)
